root_cause: Linux flock is held on file inode, not pathname. If original .nox-deepseek-owner.lock is unlinked/recreated during an HTTP Range, another process could take a new inode lock while the old worker continues appending GGUF.
fix: The existing DeepSeek downloader verifies lock path/inode/owner/mode/link count after flock and before appending each HTTP chunk; rejects preexisting group/other-accessible lock, guards final Range readback, preserves original owner STOP/lease and single download policy.
